evidence.section: SOK to Splunk Enterprise version compatibility; Upgrade path guidance
evidence.statement: Help lists SOK 3.2 with Kubernetes 1.32–1.37 and Enterprise 10.0.12–10.6.0 with Operator-first sequencing. Project changelog 3.2.0 instead lists 1.32–1.36 and restricts the queue secret reference change to Index & Ingestion Separation.
